elements.element: Cap limb (b): USD 1,000,000 floor, expressed as the greater of the two limbs

reasons: Preferred level is complete: the cap is now the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, mutual, with an uncapped Excluded Claims carve-out covering confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and the other Party's IP, plus a mutual consequential-damages exclusion.

Operation 2 was unnecessary to complete the rule: the original 21.3 already stated that Customer's payment obligation is not damages, so the preferred element on payment obligations was satisfied before the edit. Rewriting the sentence is a change beyond what the level required.

The rewrite also works against us: replacing "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" with "all amounts due" strips the customer-favourable qualifiers, so disputed amounts and amounts for non-conforming Services are now placed outside the liability cap and its protections. That degrades an untouched commercial protection rather than preserving it.
Recommended fix: revert 21.3 to "Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by this Section." and keep only the 21.1 cap edit.

Note (rationale only, not a deviation): the fallback would not be satisfied on its own terms because the cap is a greater-of construction rather than a flat 12 months' fees; this is immaterial as the drafted position sits at the preferred level.
